sql_A: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01';
sql_B: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01';
SELECT round(avg(amount),2) AS avg_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31';

sql_A:
SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;
sql_B:
SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

sql_A:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
) o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY o.total DESC
LIMIT 1;
sql_B: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.total DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders);

sql_A:
SELECT name
FROM customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
);
sql_B: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

sql_A:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o2025 ON c.customer_id = o2025.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o2025.order_date) = '2025'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM orders o2026
      WHERE o2026.customer_id = c.customer_id
        AND strftime('%Y', o2026.order_date) = '2026'
  );

SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4;
sql_B: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4) o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

sql_A:
WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-%'
  GROUP BY customer_id
), max_cnt AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt FROM order_counts
)
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN order_counts oc ON c.customer_id = oc.customer_id
JOIN max_cnt mc ON oc.cnt = mc.max_cnt;

SELECT CAST(julianday(MAX(order_date)) - julianday(MIN(order_date)) AS INTEGER)
FROM orders
JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE customers.name = 'Alice Cohen';
sql_B: SELECT julianday(max(order_date)) - julianday(min(order_date)) AS days FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE customers.name = 'Alice Cohen';

sql_A:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) AS month
FROM orders
WHERE order_date LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;
sql_B: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) AS month FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1;

sql_A:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_date) - julianday(prev_date)), 1)
FROM (
    SELECT order_date,
           LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS prev_date
    FROM orders
) t
WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL;
sql_B:
WITH diffs AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         julianday(order_date) - julianday(LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date)) AS diff
  FROM orders
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(diff), 1) AS avg_days
FROM diffs
WHERE diff IS NOT NULL;

sql_B: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS total FROM orders WHERE status='R';

sql_A: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled';
sql_B: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_not_cancelled FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled';

sql_A:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'returned';
sql_B: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='R';

sql_A:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1)
FROM orders;
sql_B: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS returned_percentage FROM orders;

SELECT round(SUM(amount), 2)
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'shipped'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025';
sql_B: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS total_shipped_2025 FROM orders WHERE status='S' AND strftime('%Y', order_date)='2025';

SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC
